MANAGER_QUERY_AND_CLEANUP.EXECUTABLE: no probe launched on predicate failure
MANAGER_QUERY_AND_CLEANUP.PROCEDURE: authenticate exact direct ubuntu01 manager/binaries/account, administrator permission for this exact one-shot command/properties/unit and output paths; verify no prior attempt, unit/receipt conflict; durably record authorized attempt before launch; unknown or ambiguous denies launch

one qualified direct-host observer launches exactly argv, captures separate stdout/stderr each bounded within aggregate65536 and monotonic25s deadline; no shell interpolation, no sudo, no fallback user manager

query once while service START snapshot is live; crosscheck MainPID with service output and host /proc/<MainPID>/cgroup; separately derive pids and name=systemd controller paths. Read pids.max/current only under exact derived service pids path. Do not use manager ControlGroup as a pids substitute.

require exact unit, nonroot UID/GID1000, MainPID correspondence, service pids=/system.slice/<unit>, kernel maximum8, configured TasksMax8, current1..8 and distinct direct controller provenance; preserve raw records/time/PIDs. Missing/mismatched fields fail. No excess-task rejection claim.

wait for launcher and independently observe terminal service Result/ExecMainStatus if retained by manager; zero exit plus both snapshots required. Collected post-exit metadata absence is not an invented successful Result; record raw not-found and verify no living service PID.

stop only this exact unit if still active or observer cap/deadline fails; within25s budget. Verify no active tasks, no persistent unit, no /run/systemd/transient/<unit>; collect or empty/remove cgroup state read-only. Never reset attempt receipt. Cleanup error secondary to first failure; no relaunch.

RETAINED_FIELDS.OBSERVATION_PROVENANCE: raw service snapshots plus independent manager/kernel/parent captures with actual times
RETAINED_FIELDS.SERVICE_EXIT_STATUS: independent manager/parent outcome; no success inferred from collection or service self-report
RETAINED_FIELDS.SERVICE_PROCESS_ID: payload SERVICE_PID independently matches manager MainPID and host /proc/<PID>/cgroup
RETAINED_FIELDS.SERVICE_SYSTEMD_CGROUP: separately captured own name=systemd path, never used as pids substitute
